items.exampleEn: The school superintendent visited every classroom in the district.
items.exampleZh: 學區督導走訪了區內的每一間教室。

items.exampleEn: The report was written by a governmental agency.
items.exampleZh: 這份報告是由一個政府機構撰寫的。

items.exampleEn: In the novel, a corrupt judge sells his decisions to rich families.
items.exampleZh: 在那本小說裡，一位腐敗的法官把判決賣給有錢人家。

items.exampleEn: The old battlefield is now a quiet park with tall trees.
items.exampleZh: 那個古戰場現在是一座有高大樹木的寧靜公園。

items.exampleEn: He is a strong partisan of free public transport.
items.exampleZh: 他是免費大眾運輸的堅定支持者。
items.glossZh: （某黨派或主張的）堅定支持者

items.exampleEn: She has worked as the company's spokeswoman for six years.
items.exampleZh: 她擔任那家公司的女發言人已經六年了。

items.exampleEn: A racist is someone who treats people unfairly because of their race.
items.exampleZh: 種族主義者是因為種族而不公平對待別人的人。
items.glossZh: 種族主義者；種族歧視者

items.exampleEn: The history class learned about a massacre that happened centuries ago.
items.exampleZh: 歷史課學到一場發生在幾百年前的大屠殺。

items.sentenceEn: A spokeswoman for the airline said the flight was delayed by fog.
items.sentenceZh: 航空公司的女發言人表示，班機因為起霧而延誤。

items.audioEn: The superintendent said the water will be turned off from two to four this afternoon.
items.audioZh: 大樓管理員說今天下午兩點到四點會停水。
options: For two hours from two o'clock
From one o'clock to three o'clock
From four o'clock until the evening

items.sentenceEn: The kitchen became a battlefield when both chefs wanted the same stove.
items.sentenceZh: 兩位廚師都想用同一個爐子時，廚房就變成了戰場。

items.sentenceEn: The film tells the story of a racist who slowly learns to respect others.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影講述一個種族主義者慢慢學會尊重別人的故事。

items.stemEn: A stone memorial reminds visitors of the ____ that took place here in 1750.
items.stemZh: 一座石碑提醒遊客，1750 年這裡曾發生過一場大屠殺。

items.stemEn: Taking money in secret from builders is a ____ practice.
items.stemZh: 私下收取建商的錢是一種貪腐的行為。

items.passageEn: Last week, the water in our apartment building suddenly turned brown. The superintendent called the city water department, a governmental office that checks water quality. Workers investigated the problem and found that old pipes under our street were the cause. The next day, a spokeswoman for the department said on the radio that the pipes would be replaced within a month. At a neighborhood meeting, some partisans of a bigger water plan wanted the city to move faster, but most people were happy with the promise.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們公寓大樓的水突然變成褐色。大樓管理員打電話給市政府的自來水處，那是負責檢查水質的政府機關。工作人員調查後發現，原因出在我們街道底下的老舊水管。隔天，自來水處的女發言人在廣播中說，水管會在一個月內換新。在住戶會議上，一些支持更大規模供水計畫的人希望市政府動作快一點，不過大部分人對這個承諾感到滿意。

questions.questionZh: 水變成褐色的原因是什麼？
options: 大樓水塔太久沒有清洗

questions.questionZh: 大部分住戶對這件事的態度如何？

items.promptZh: 那部電影講的是一位對抗貪腐市長的年輕記者。
referenceEn: The film is about a young reporter who fights a corrupt mayor.
That movie tells the story of a young reporter fighting against a corrupt mayor.
rubricZh: 要用 corrupt（例如 a corrupt mayor、a mayor who was corrupt 等）
「對抗」可寫，例如 fight、fight against、stand up to 等
「講的是」可寫，例如 is about、tells the story of 等

items.instructionZh: 用 spokeswoman 造一個句子，說說某家公司或機構的女發言人說了什麼。
referenceEn: A spokeswoman for the zoo said the baby elephant was healthy.
The bank's spokeswoman said that the new online service would start next month.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 spokeswoman（例如 a spokeswoman for…、the bank's spokeswoman）
說了什麼可用不同方式表達，例如引述、轉述（said that…）等
時態配合內容（例如 said、says 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：裁示「聽選正解不可照抄音檔」：正解改寫成同義說法，干擾項沿用音檔裡的字
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["From two to four", "From one to three", "For the whole afternoon", "After four o'clock"]；改後：["For two hours from two o'clock", "From one to three", "For the whole afternoon", "From four o'clock on"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：裁示「長度名次單批也要在 13–37%」：本批聽選正解最長偏多，加長干擾項（不改正解意思、干擾項仍不成立）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前：["For two hours from two o'clock", "From one to three", "For the whole afternoon", "From four o'clock on"]；改後：["For two hours from two o'clock", "From one o'clock to three o'clock", "For the whole afternoon", "From four o'clock until the evening"]

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關 issue 結案：partisan 用於球隊支持者（Partisans of both teams sang loudly throughout the match）不自然，partisan 通常指政黨／主張的支持者，球迷應是 supporters／fans；建議例句改為某項主張或計畫的支持者情境（閱讀短文 partisans of a bigger water plan 的用法較合適）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：見本檔 resolvedAfterFinalReview 中 items/4 的修正紀錄。

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：裁示「評分要點不寫死結構」全批掃描：表語用法也正確
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改前："要用 corrupt 修飾名詞（例如 a corrupt mayor）"；改後："要用 corrupt（例如 a corrupt mayor、a mayor who was corrupt 等）"
